title: Answer Context Receipt QA
principle: Every answer should make context use visible without exposing raw prompts, responses, provider secrets or paid routes.
public_repo_rule: Receipts are metadata-only browser-local records: no prompts, no responses, no provider keys, no public secrets.

scenarios.expected: A backend answer records model, route, role, history count and whether local/backend memory or knowledge was used.
Browser guide and install-path answers receive a receipt that marks memory and knowledge as none.
A compact Context summary is injected under each assistant answer and can expand into safe metadata.
Receipt fields explicitly state local-only, no provider secrets, no raw prompt stored and no raw response stored.
